channels.name: Mainband data lanes
channels.direction: uni-directional per module (output on TX module, input on RX module)
channels.purpose: Carry Flit (or Raw) data across the die-to-die channel.
channels.active_levels: single-ended NRZ at 4-32 GT/s; 16 lanes (Standard) or 64 lanes (Advanced) per module
channels.idle_level: Valid de-asserted; forwarded clock kept running

channels.name: Valid lane
channels.purpose: Frames/qualifies the mainband data on the module.
channels.active_levels: single-ended; asserted when data lanes carry valid data

channels.name: Track / Clock lane
channels.purpose: Forwarded source-synchronous clock / calibration-track for the mainband.
channels.active_levels: single-ended forwarded clock at the lane rate

channels.name: txdatasb / rxdatasb (sideband data)
channels.idle_level: always-on; idle frames when no traffic

channels.name: vccaon / vccio / vss
channels.purpose: Always-on power, IO power, ground rails interleaved in the bump map.

logical_signaling_levels.name: Active mainband
logical_signaling_levels.meaning: Single-ended NRZ data on the module's data lanes, framed by Valid, strobed by the forwarded Track/clock.

logical_signaling_levels.name: Mainband idle
logical_signaling_levels.meaning: Valid de-asserted; no valid data; forwarded clock continues.

logical_signaling_levels.name: Sideband traffic
logical_signaling_levels.meaning: Always-on 800 MHz management/register/training packets, independent of the mainband.

global_signals.name: Sideband
global_signals.purpose: Always-on 800 MHz management/training/register channel for the whole Link.

dependency_graph.common_rule: Each module is source-synchronous: data lanes are sampled against that module's forwarded Track/clock, qualified by the Valid lane. The sideband must be up before the mainband can be trained/negotiated. Multi-module Links de-skew and align modules. TX and RX modules are independent (a Link pairs them for full-duplex).
dependency_graph.data_dependency: Flit transmission requires: (1) sideband up, (2) mainband trained at the negotiated rate, (3) D2D Adapter ACTIVE (or Raw Mode agreed). Reliable delivery requires the Adapter's CRC + Retry; Raw Mode requires the carried protocol's own reliability.

handshake_pairs.name: FDI valid/credit
handshake_pairs.rule: Flit-Aware Die-to-Die Interface flow control between Protocol and Adapter.

handshake_pairs.name: RDI valid/credit
handshake_pairs.rule: Raw Die-to-Die Interface flow control between Adapter and PHY (also the Raw-Mode data path).

handshake_pairs.name: Flit-CRC-Retry
handshake_pairs.rule: 16-bit CRC check; on mismatch request Retry of the sequence-numbered Flit.

handshake_pairs.name: Sideband-param-exchange
handshake_pairs.rule: Negotiate data rate / width / protocol / Flit format over the always-on sideband.

handshake_pairs.name: Valid-framing
handshake_pairs.rule: Valid lane qualifies which UI carry mainband data.

handshake_pairs.name: Lane-repair
handshake_pairs.rule: Remap failing lane to a spare (Advanced) or degrade width (Standard) during training.

ordering_rules.bit_order_on_wire: Single-ended NRZ per data lane, source-synchronous to the forwarded clock; no line-code block boundaries.
ordering_rules.flit_order: Flits are ordered by the Flit-header sequence number for retry/replay.
ordering_rules.lane_striping: Mainband data is striped across the module's data lanes (16 Std / 64 Adv); multi-module Links de-skew across modules.
ordering_rules.tx_rx_simultaneity: Full-duplex: TX and RX modules operate independently and simultaneously; the sideband is full-duplex (2 lanes/direction).
